text:
elena: Heads-up — onboarding nova-17b checkpoint. Found a couple of weirds: weights symlink points to an s3 path with mixed separators, tokenizer.json contains a leading BOM which is causing token mismatch, and safetensors metadata shows TP layout as \"tp_major\" but our loader expects \"shard_major\". pinging infra + conversion folks for quick sync.

jonathan: @elena can you paste the exact weights path? i can check the symlink handling in the loader.

elena: path is s3://redwood-models/nova/17b//final\u005ccheckpoint (yeah double slash + backslash from windows export). the conversion script assumed posix.

maya: BOM on tokenizer is classic — was the tokenizer exported from huggingface-cli or from custom script? if HF, we can reserialize with tokenizer.save_pretrained and force encoding utf-8-sig removal.

elena: exported via a one-off script (PR #842). quick fix is to strip \uFEFF at load time. small snippet i ran locally:```python
with open('tokenizer.json','r',encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
    tok = f.read()
# then json.loads(tok)
```
worked for my local tests.

sam: re: symlink — our s3 sync step normalizes posix separators but not backslashes. i'll add a sanitize step in the ingestion lambda. temporary workaround: replace \\ with / when building the S3 key.

jonathan: about the TP layout mismatch — do we have a deterministic reorder script? i hit a similar case where TP=2 created 8 shards but the naming scheme differed.

elena: exact safetensors metadata snippet I saw: `{"tp_layout":"tp_major","tp_size":2,"shards":8}`. our serve-config wants \"layout\":\"shard_major\". conversion command i used: `safetensors-convert --src hf --dst safetensors --tp 2 nova-17b` but the tool has a `--layout` flag i missed. quick check to validate ordering:```bash
python -c "from safetensors import safe_open; print(safe_open('model_shard_000.safetensors').metadata)"
```
prints the layout metadata.

maya: nice. i can add a small validator that ensures metadata.layout matches serve-config before publishing. if mismatch -> block publish and attach conversion diff.

ci-bot: build #1769 — small-conversion-test triggered for nova-17b subset. status: running.

elena: decision: i will add a regen step to PR #842 to remove BOM and re-run conversion with `--layout shard_major`. @jonathan can you add a serve-config flag to tolerate both layouts for 2 weeks? we want graceful fallback.

jonathan: yep i can add `tp_layout_hint` to serve-config and default to strict after the grace window. will open PR targeting staging.

sam: i'll patch the ingestion lambda to normalize paths. will also add a log when non-posix separators found so we catch exporters.

maya: i'll push the validator to the packaging CI and add a test that ensures tokenizer loads with utf-8 and utf-8-sig.

ci-bot: build #1769 — small-conversion-test succeeded for shards 0-2, failed on 3 due to unexpected token ids (likely tokenization BOM).

elena: thanks all. action items: elena->update PR #842 (regen tokenizer + convert with layout), jonathan->serve-config PR (tp_layout_hint), sam->ingest sanitize, maya->packaging validator. aim to merge today. :thumbsup:

jonathan: ping me when PR is up, i'll do quick review.

maya: if anyone wants the tiny script i used to detect BOM, lmk, i'll drop it in the PR.

elena: posted script in PR comment. CI re-run queued.

ci-bot: build #1770 queued.
